subject: Family and School Partnerships Platform
overview: Lisa Kingsley discussed her election platform regarding the necessity of authentic partnerships between families and schools through systemic district-wide improvements.

items.title: Authentic Family Engagement Platform
items.summary: Lisa Kingsley outlined a platform focused on creating systemic district-wide supports for authentic engagement between families and schools to better meet student needs.

items.title: Systemic Improvements and Data Transparency
items.summary: Proposed systemic changes included standardizing communication software and sharing student testing data with families as it is collected rather than waiting for report cards.
